Subject: MAP draft: security intake sprintcard + SOC 2 deliverables

Hi Oliver — thanks again for a productive call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps to keep the MAP moving toward your target close: 

1) Security review & SOC 2 package (milestone):
   - Deliverables: completed SOC 2 questionnaire, evidence bundle (system architecture diagram, access controls, retention policy, audit logs sample), contact for security SSO test.
   - Owner (Redwood): Grace O'Connor
   - Owner (Greenbridge): Oliver Barnes / Procurement Team (to accept policy docs)
   - Target due date: 2026-08-12 (we've suggested 2 weeks to compile)
   - Dependencies: procurement legal review + confidentiality addendum signed; access request for architecture diagram; procurement to share SOC-related baseline checklist

2) Product demo + performance baseline: 2026-08-05 (Redwood demo team)
3) Procurement terms / pricing sign-off: 2026-08-19 (Ben to lead)
4) Final canary rollout & validation: 2026-08-26 (Laura to coordinate SRE/CS)

I've attached a draft MAP spreadsheet (Draft_MAP_v0.9.xlsx) with milestones and owners. Please confirm the security milestone deadline above and any additional evidence you need beyond the questionnaire.

Attachments: Draft_MAP_v0.9.xlsx (attachment stub)

Thanks,
Grace

Hi Grace — appreciate the clear recap. A few notes from our side: 

- Target due date 2026-08-12 for SOC 2 artifacts sounds reasonable, but procurement will need until 2026-08-16 to complete the legal review unless we can fast-track the CDA.
- We'll need the SOC 2 questionnaire in editable form (PDF is fine but Word/Sheets preferred so our security team can annotate). Can you attach?
- For evidence, a sample audit-log extract and a short data retention table would be most helpful — we typically ask for the log schema + a 3-day sample.

I'll loop procurement on this thread; my expectation is we can keep the overall MAP timeline but may push the procurement sign-off to 2026-08-20 if the CDA takes longer.

Thanks,
